comment: Fixed OD pairs logged hourly. Frozen BEFORE the Sept 11 2026 I-5 SB Rose Quarter closure so the before-baseline and the during-closure data are collected identically. Do not edit pairs after logging begins; add new ones with new ids instead.

pairs.name: Delta Park -> OMSI
pairs.why: a trip that normally uses the closed I-5 SB span; its travel-time jump is the closure cost

pairs.name: Vancouver WA -> Pioneer Courthouse Sq
pairs.why: the classic I-5 SB commute through the closed span

pairs.name: Rosa Parks/I-5 -> PSU
pairs.why: should divert to the signed I-405 detour during the closure; length_m jumps reveal the reroute

pairs.name: Kenton -> Broadway Bridge east
pairs.why: N Interstate Ave, the surface street parallel to closed I-5

pairs.name: Broadway Bridge east -> Kenton
pairs.why: reverse of interstate_sb (Williams/Vancouver couplet), direction control

pairs.name: NE Columbia/MLK -> SE Stark/Grand
pairs.why: MLK Blvd southbound, the eastside surface alternative

pairs.name: SE Stark/Grand -> NE Columbia/MLK
pairs.why: reverse couplet (Grand Ave northbound), direction control

pairs.name: Airport Way -> Foster via I-205
pairs.why: the regional detour; redundant with PORTAL detectors on purpose, cross-checks the logger

pairs.name: NE 82nd/I-84 -> Moda Center
pairs.why: I-84 WB approach; the WB-to-SB movement closes, so this feeder congests

pairs.name: SE 82nd/Powell -> Ross Island Bridge
pairs.why: the project's validation corridor; may absorb eastside diversion

pairs.name: Washington Square -> Hillsboro
pairs.why: far-field control, should NOT move with the closure

pairs.name: Gresham -> Lents
pairs.why: far-field control on the east side
